Hi Jane,

Thanks again for the call this morning - great to meet you and outline AcmeHealth's requirements.

- Attached: preliminary DPA draft and an SCC module selection spreadsheet for your legal team to review.
- Can you confirm whether you require SCCs (standard contractual clauses) for transfers, and if so, which modules your legal team prefers?
- Also, could you share AcmeHealth's vendor security questionnaire? If you prefer, we can fill it out directly and return.

Action items:
1) Jane: confirm controller/processor alignment and upload vendor questionnaire.
2) Rishi/Redwood: provide SOC 2 Type II report and final DPA draft once we align on SCCs.
3) Schedule legal-to-legal call once DPA/SCC selection is agreed.

Thanks,

Redwood Inference

Hi Jane, Rishi,

Thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers and next steps:

- Role alignment: Redwood will be the data processor; AcmeHealth will be the data controller. We will reflect this in the attached DPA draft.
- SCCs: For cross-border transfers from the EU/UK to the US we recommend using the Controller-to-Processor module. See the attached SCC_Module_Selection.xlsx for our recommended mapping.
- SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report covering the period ending 2026-12-31. Attached is the report (redacted copy). If you prefer, we can provide a secure link or execute an NDA for the full report.
- HIPAA/BAA: Redwood supports HIPAA-regulated workloads and we can execute a BAA. Attached is our BAA template for review.

Next steps:
1) Please review the attached Redwood_DPA_Draft_20270301.pdf and SCC selection spreadsheet and confirm any edits.
2) We will complete the vendor security questionnaire and return by EOD tomorrow.
3) If helpful, propose 2 available 30-minute slots for a legal-to-legal call and we'll confirm.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_Draft_20270301.pdf, SOC2_Report_2026.pdf, HIPAA_BAA_Template.pdf, SCC_Module_Selection.xlsx
